title: 🔥 Stunning Text Effect with Animated GIF Background Using Pure CSS! 🚀
description:
💡 Want to create an eye-catching text effect? This project showcases a beautiful text animation using background-clip: text and a moving GIF background! 🎨✨

✔ Features:
✅ Pure HTML & CSS – No JavaScript needed! ⚡
✅ Background Clip Text Effect for an awesome see-through GIF effect. 🔥
✅ Fully Responsive & Cross-Browser Compatible 🌍
✅ Gradient Background for a clean and modern look. 🎨
✅ Optimized & Clean Code with comments for easy understanding. 📝

🚀 Perfect for:
✔ Web designers & developers looking for cool UI effects.
✔ Anyone wanting to enhance their CSS animation skills.
✔ Creative projects that need animated text magic! ✨
